scope: Independent saved-state and exact-measure reconstruction; no producer imports or new trajectory solves. Scramble comparisons are empirical, not rigorous error bounds.

inverse_cutoff_diagnostic.scope: Kinematic cutoff-closure diagnostic: magnitudes of inverse incident data at outgoing finite planes; includes transmitted and reflected exits with exact original incoming flux weights. No detailed-balance or physical-rate claim.

normalized_kick_ratio.scope: Ratio of normalized accumulated squared kicks on the bounded incoming band; not an actual relaxation/mixing-time ratio or a kinetic closure. Born mean control leaves this ratio unchanged.

narrow_same_B2_reference.scope: Same B2 and impact band with narrower parallel/perpendicular speed bands; this is a domain comparison, not a stronger-field comparison.
